reasons: The inserted subsection (c) supplies every atomic preferred element: professional and workmanlike Services (two distinct standards), a 90-day Services period, express conformance of the Site, deliverables and software to documentation for 12 months, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and all three remedies (repair, replacement, refund).
The insertion is a concise addition addressing an absent performance warranty; the existing mutual authority warranties in 9(a) and the Globix carve-out in 9(b) are untouched and remain effective.
No undefined terms are introduced: "Services" is defined in the inserted text and the conformance trigger cross-references the existing acceptance mechanic in Section 5.2.
Fallback thresholds are also comfortably exceeded, but the drafter's locked preferred target is independently satisfied, so no downgrade is needed.
